findings.summary: Label.new_name uses snake_case while all other config interfaces use camelCase
evidence: src/config/types.ts:375: new_name?: string; — in Label interface
GitHubRepoSettings uses camelCase (hasIssues, allowSquashMerge) with camelToSnake() conversion for API calls
Label.new_name directly uses the GitHub API snake_case key instead of following the camelCase + conversion pattern
findings.suggestion: Rename to newName in the Label interface and convert to new_name at the API boundary (in converter.ts), matching the GitHubRepoSettings pattern that uses camelToSnake().

findings.summary: FileChange and RulesetChange type names are duplicated across modules with different shapes
evidence: src/vcs/types.ts:153: export interface FileChange { path: string; content: string | null; }
src/output/sync-report.ts:20: export interface FileChange { path: string; action: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete'; }
src/settings/rulesets/diff.ts:8: export interface RulesetChange { action: RulesetAction; name: string; rulesetId?: number; ... }
src/output/settings-report.ts:30: export interface RulesetChange { name: string; action: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete'; propertyDiffs?: ... }
findings.suggestion: Distinguish with module-specific prefixes or suffixes: VcsFileChange vs ReportFileChange, DiffRulesetChange vs ReportRulesetChange. This prevents confusion when both types appear in the same scope.

findings.summary: Three settings strategy classes import defaultExecutor singleton as fallback instead of requiring injection
findings.suggestion: Make executor a required constructor parameter in all three strategy classes, and supply defaultExecutor at the composition root (cli/types.ts factory functions). This aligns with the CLAUDE.md principle that library code must not import singletons.

findings.summary: src/shared/gh-api-utils.ts imports type from src/vcs/, violating the shared→domain dependency direction
evidence: resolveGitHubToken function accepts GitHubAppTokenManager directly rather than a narrower interface
findings.suggestion: Define a narrow interface (e.g., { getTokenForRepo(repo: GitHubRepoInfo): Promise<string | null | undefined> }) in shared/ and have GitHubAppTokenManager implement it. This removes the upward type dependency from shared to vcs.

findings.summary: Two shared modules import ValidationError class from config/errors.ts (runtime dependency, not type-only)
evidence: retry-utils uses instanceof ValidationError check; repo-detector throws ValidationError
findings.suggestion: Move ValidationError to src/shared/errors.ts since it is used across multiple modules. This makes shared self-contained and removes the upward dependency from shared to config.

findings.summary: output/settings-report.ts imports formatPropertyTree from settings/, creating an unexpected output→domain dependency
evidence: src/output/settings-report.ts:2: import { formatPropertyTree, type PropertyDiff } from '../settings/index.js';
findings.suggestion: Extract formatPropertyTree and PropertyDiff into src/shared/ or src/output/ since they are pure formatting utilities with no domain logic. This keeps the output module independent of settings.
